user.description: Choose the diffuser to set up.

confirm.description: Set up {name}? Close the vendor app on your phone first: the diffuser accepts only one connection.

data_description.name: Shown in Home Assistant and, later, in the Apple Home app.

password.description: The diffuser is protected by an app password.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect. Make sure the phone app is closed and the diffuser is in range of a Bluetooth adapter or proxy.

data_description.keep_connected: Instant control and live state. Turn off to let the phone app connect between commands (control then takes a few seconds).

command_failed.message: The diffuser did not accept the command: {error}

no_enabled_mode.message: Intensity and spray time are stored in the working modes, and none is enabled. Enable a mode first.

unknown_mode.message: The diffuser has no working mode {mode}. Create it in the vendor app first.

not_found.message: Diffuser {address} is not in range of any connectable Bluetooth adapter or proxy.

cannot_connect.message: Could not connect to the diffuser: {error}

invalid_password.message: The diffuser rejected the password. Remove and re-add the integration.

set_working_mode.name: Set working mode
set_working_mode.description: Change a working mode (schedule) stored on the diffuser. Only the fields you fill in are changed.

mode.name: Mode
mode.description: Working mode number, as in the app.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Turn the mode on or off.
